summary: MDJM LTD, via its wholly-owned UK subsidiary Mansions Catering and Hotel LTD, filed a 6-K reporting entry into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 75% of Mirai Co., Ltd., a Japan-based supply chain company, for US$1,000,000 in cash. The acquisition price is payable in three installments: US$290,000 paid, US$290,000 due upon regulatory approval of share transfer, and US$420,000 after post-closing conditions including audited financials and Nasdaq review. Board recommendation not stated; advisor is Broad Investment Securities LLC for a US$200,000 fee. Expected close on or around May 13, 2026. Watch for regulatory approval under Japanese law and Nasdaq compliance; risk-arb angle hinges on post-closing audit and potential unwinding if conditions not met.
